en.t: Once you get addicted, it is terrible.

units.source_text: 聽老闆娘這麼一說，我才發現，自己已經嚴重上癮

en.t: When I heard the proprietress say that, I realized that I was already badly addicted.

units.source_text: （實際上我對別人的暗示很敏感，很容易受到影響。

en.t: In fact, I was very sensitive to other people's suggestions and was easily influenced by them.

units.source_text: 比如別人跟我說「這筆錢不能花啊，不過嘛這是你自己的事」，

en.t: For example, if someone said to me, You must not spend this money, though of course it is your own affair,

units.source_text: 我就會產生一種奇怪的錯覺，覺得不花掉那筆錢，反而辜負了對方的期待，所以一定會馬上花掉）。

en.t: I would fall into the strange delusion that not spending it would somehow betray that person's expectations, and so I would always spend it right away.

units.source_text: 由於上癮的不安，我對藥品的需求越來越多。

en.t: Because of my anxiety over the addiction, my need for the drug kept growing.

units.source_text: 「拜託了！再給我拿一盒吧，月底我一定會把藥費帶過來。」

en.t: Please, I beg you! Give me one more box. I will definitely bring the payment for the medicine at the end of the month.

units.source_text: 「錢沒關係啦，什麼時候都行，只是警察追查起來很煩。」

en.t: The money does not matter. Whenever you pay is fine. It is just that it becomes troublesome if the police start looking into it.
